title: Route the adjacent-BU dominant-client-commitment rule into canonical daytime decision work
summary: The 2026-04-22 overnight portfolio pass again found the same strongest bottleneck: the adjacent-BU boundary cluster across Consulting, Advice & Board Participation, and Education & Mentoring is decision-ready and still waiting on daytime judgment rather than more overnight analysis. Create one canonical decision item so the portfolio does not rely only on repeated carry-forward surfaces.

body.summary: Convert the repeatedly reaffirmed adjacent-BU boundary issue into one explicit canonical daytime decision item. The decision to make is still narrow: accept, accept with wording edits, or reject the dominant-client-commitment rule already prepared in the daytime review packet. If accepted, the immediate same-cycle follow-through is charter patching for the three affected BUs and then explicit routing of any resulting model-impacting boundary canonization through the existing CP-001 path under the Model Change Protocol.
